question: The SI unit of power of lens is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**dioptre**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dioptre** is the **SI unit of power of the lens**, which measures the refractive power of a lens or the ability of a lens to bend light.
 
• Candela is the SI unit of luminous intensity, which measures the amount of light emitted per second in a particular direction.
 
• Mole is the SI unit of amount of substance, which measures the number of elementary entities (such as atoms, molecules, ions, etc.) in a given sample of matter.
 
• Watt is the SI unit of power, which measures the rate of energy transfer or conversion per unit time.
